name: Etoranze ~Uchi no Pet wa Neko no Kami-sama?~
original_name: えとランゼ～うちのペットは猫の神様？～
source:
Main character's sister returns from a distant town on the first day after summer vacation. There is nothing special in the return itself, but the strange thing is that she is possessed by a cat God. The deity promises to return sister's personality is protagonist helps with finding and hunting monsters. But the real problem is that she messes with everyone turning ordinary life into chaos.

[Modified from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-november-2006-haruka-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暑假结束后的第一天，主人公的妹妹从远方城镇归来。她回家本身并没有什么特别，奇怪的是，她竟被一位猫神附身了。神明承诺，只要主人公协助寻找并猎杀怪物，就会归还妹妹的人格。然而真正的问题在于，这位神明总爱捉弄身边所有人，把原本平静的日常生活搅得一团糟。

[修改自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-november-2006-haruka-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
